title: Project stage governance
description: Evidence and decisions for a team managing a project in PRINCE2 stages.

sources.title: PeopleCert, PRINCE2 7: A Process of Evolution

rules.instruction: At stage start, agree on the products due, acceptance criteria, resources and tolerances the team can work within. Assign decisions beyond those tolerances to the agreed escalation owner.
rules.verification: Ask the project manager to explain which forecast would trigger escalation and trace that threshold to an approved stage plan.

rules.instruction: Before committing to the next stage, review what was accepted, what remains open and whether the current business case still supports continuing.
rules.verification: Record the sponsor's decision and its evidence, including updated assumptions and any conditions on the next stage.

rules.instruction: At closure, hand over accepted products with unresolved items and operational owners. Agree who will review expected benefits and when.
rules.verification: Match each outstanding item to a handover entry and confirm that the benefits review has an owner and date.
